supervisor_summary: STM's 2027 recovery is guided (Q3 $3.70B, Q4 above $4B, datacenter well above $2B in 2027, $18B 2028 model reaffirmed), but margins trail every peer, so fair value at the horizon is ~$47.6, about 4% below the $49.57 close. Round-2 checks settled the per-share bridge: ~914M diluted shares including customer warrants, $406M minorities, an 18% guided tax rate, 15.2% 2026 capex, and a 10.8% WACC on a sourced 4.20% ERP and a reproduced beta. These corrections offset one another, the reconciled value equals the forecaster mean, and confidence is low. Three prints in the next month (TXN Oct 21, NXP Oct 27, ST Oct 29) keep the one-month distribution wide.
key_drivers: The recovery is guided: Q3 $3.70B at 37% GM, Q4 above $4B, datacenter above $1B in 2026 and well above $2B in 2027, and the $18B 2028 model reaffirmed. Consensus FY27 is $17.18B revenue and $2.69 EPS after SBC.

Margins are the swing factor: FY25 GAAP operating margin was 1.5% against 26.7% at the 2023 peak. Management's 2027-28 model is 22-24%; the reconciled path is 15% in FY27 and 19% in FY28, held down by SiC losses and capital intensity (2026 net capex at the high end of $2.0-2.2B, ~15% of revenue).

Multiple: 17x NTM GAAP EPS (~$2.97) against a verified next-FY peer median of 16.6x (~17.5x like-for-like after SBC) and a consensus-blend NTM median of ~18.0x (estimate). 17x implies a 9.5% WACC against the 10.8% used in the DCF, so the DCF ($42.3) sits below the multiple leg ($50.4).
Per-share bridge: 913.7M diluted shares (895.35M basic + 7.7M awards + 10.6M customer warrants at $28.38), $1,701M adjusted net cash, $406M minorities, tax at the guided 18%.
Event risk: realized vol of 61%, 5 of the last 7 results-day moves negative, and three prints (TXN Oct 21, NXP Oct 27, ST Oct 29) within a month.
